title: Outline vs border
learningObjectives: Explain outline vs border and apply it in a practical page layout.

understand.concept: A border is part of the element's box and affects its box dimensions. An outline is drawn outside the border edge and generally does not take up layout space. outline-offset moves it away from the element.
understand.whyItMatters: Outlines are useful for focus indicators because they can appear without changing layout. Do not remove keyboard focus styling unless you replace it with a clear visible alternative.
understand.analogy: A border is part of the frame; an outline is like a visible marker drawn around the outside.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is only a learning aid; actual sizing and layout follow CSS formatting rules.

explain.narrative: Use the keyboard to focus the button. The outline appears outside the border and does not shift surrounding layout.

examples.explanation: Use the keyboard to focus the button. The outline appears outside the border and does not shift surrounding layout.
examples.expectedOutput: A rendered example that demonstrates the topic's CSS behaviour.

practise.guidedTask: Style a button with a border and a strong :focus-visible outline. Verify keyboard focus is easy to see.
practise.independentTask: Build a small component that demonstrates this concept. Test it with longer content and at a narrow viewport.
hints: Change one value at a time.
Inspect computed styles in developer tools.
Check keyboard and touch access when the example has controls.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Outline vs border</title></head><body>
<button class='action'>Continue</button><style>.action{padding:.7rem 1rem;border:1px solid #456;border-radius:.5rem}.action:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #e76f51;outline-offset:3px}</style>
</body></html>

questions.prompt: Which property draws a visual ring without taking up layout space?
questions.explanation: An outline is drawn outside the border and does not participate in box sizing.
